entries.title: Psalms 147:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, [and] praise is comely.

entries.title: Psalms 147:2
segments: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 147:3
segments: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.

entries.title: Psalms 147:4
segments: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by [their] names.

entries.title: Psalms 147:5
segments: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.

entries.title: Psalms 147:6
segments: Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 147:7
segments: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,

entries.title: Psalms 147:8
segments: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 147:9
segments: He giveth to the beast his food, [And] to the young ravens which cry.

entries.title: Psalms 147:10
segments: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.

entries.title: Psalms 147:11
segments: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his lovingkindness.

entries.title: Psalms 147:12
segments: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 147:13
segments: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.

entries.title: Psalms 147:14
segments: He maketh peace in thy borders; He filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

entries.title: Psalms 147:15
segments: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.

entries.title: Psalms 147:16
segments: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.

entries.title: Psalms 147:17
segments: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?

entries.title: Psalms 147:18
segments: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

entries.title: Psalms 147:19
segments: He showeth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his ordinances unto Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 147:20
segments: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for his ordinances, they have not known them. Praise ye Jehovah.
